pages.text: Soul gems are diamonds set in precious metals, which are then infused with a $(#AA00AA)Djinni$().$(br) The spirit creates a small dimension that allows the temporary entrapment of living beings.$(br) Beings of great power or size cannot be stored, $()

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To capture an entity, $(#AA00AA)right-click$() it with the soul gem. $(br)$(#AA00AA)right-click$() again to release the entity.$(br2)Bosses cannot be captured.$(br)
